src.label: Australian Department of Agriculture (Micor) — Jordan dogs, based on Jordan Ministry of Agriculture advice of 27 November 2025

head: Jordan told Australia it no longer issues import permits for pet cats and dogs.
lines: The Australian agriculture department says the Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture advised it on 27 November 2025 that import permits for pet cats and dogs will no longer be issued.

The animal must still travel with a veterinary health certificate stating it is free of rabies and has been vaccinated against rabies, and only two pets of each species (cats and dogs) are allowed per traveller.
The page directs questions to the Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture at Agri@moa.gov.jo. This is Australian guidance, so confirm with the ministry before travel.
